_source: TapGameplay walkthrough parts 1-2 (youtu.be/ygiUgG6qMHI and part 2), read frame by frame. Chapters play once each, in order of their trigger. Step kinds: say (dialogue box, tap to continue), popup (New Island card), focus (dim the screen, bouncing arrow, only the target works).

steps.text: Welcome to Monster Squad!
There are seeds that grant special powers in Sprout Island.
Test your powers while exploring Sprout Island.
Investigate Sprout Island
Hello! We're going to form the world's strongest monster squad to stop the dark lord's return.
You'll meet all kinds of monsters on the island. Let's set off together!
See, some monsters hide around the island. You need to use Energy to fight them.
You can also take your friend's monsters. Sometimes, you'll make new friends!
We can attack on our own, but we need your help to use special skills.
Tap to use my skills.
Nice work! Take control of your leader monster and sub monsters' skills to excel in combat!
Tap it quickly! Your monsters are counting on you!
Wonderful! Once you're comfortable using skills, you can increase the battle speed by 1.4x to speed things up!
Good job! A new monster might join us thanks to your hard work!
Let's keep it up!

Two is better than one♪
Three is better than two♬
Head to the Team and put me in the third slot!

This is the Team tab!
Now, go find me in the Inventory and tap me!
I'll show up in that empty third slot!

Thanks!
This is a good slot.
I LOVE the third monster slot.

Too much pressure being the first!
That's only for team leader who determines team type.
Too much pressure for me!
Anyway, you can switch slots by touching monsters like that. Handy, right?
Thanks to you, the world will be at peace again.
I have a present for you. Do you want to follow me to the [Store]?
This is it! The Store is where energy and gold flow like water. You can use your gems and friend points here.
First, let's meet a new monster using your friend points.
Did you get the monster you wanted? Using the Friendship Cube is a great way to get monsters easily.
This time, let's use gems to get a stronger monster from the Yellow Cube.
Nice job! A powerful monster has become your ally! I can tell the monster is eager to battle. Head to the next field!
Equip new monsters here.
Your new monster has super high HP. Set it as your leader!
This is more field on Sprout Island. Good luck!
Let's try and edit the team. By matching Skill and attributes, depending on what Monster is selected as the Leader, a unique team can be made...

notes.text: Select this slot to remove the Monster from the team.
Press and holding down on the Monster to show information about the Monster / Skill.

(1) Select the team slot.
[Select] will appear.
(2) Selecting the desired Monster will place it into the selected team slot.

steps.text:
If you are stuck in the game, try pressing the question mark button.

You can view helpful tips again.

Hey, you!
Don't forget to take your reward for completing today's mission!
You can find more information on the main. Tap the scroll that says [Today].
This is a list of missions that gives you various rewards.
Touch the (Receive All) button to collect rewards for all the missions you've completed so far.
You did so well on today's mission! You'll be able to complete the missions for this week, no problem.

Looks doable, right?
Keep working on daily rewards, and you'll finish the week off strong!
I hope you get lots of mission rewards.
Some of the more challenging missions don't have a time limit. These will probably be hard to finish in a day or two.
These missions don't have a time limit, but they're a little tougher. You'll can still clear them while traveling around an island.
Sometimes it's best to put in the effort early to get more rewards later!

Wow, you explored all of Sprout Island!
But Lake Island won't be so easy!
I'll teach you how to boost your monster's stat.
First, Touch the monster to boost.
Touch a material monster! It shall be content to help boosting.
Boost PT are given when boost fails. Earned Boost PT add to the success rate.
Your leader's HP, Offense, and Recovery have increased by 5%! You can enhance it up to 5 times to increase its stats by 25%!
But you can't use higher-ranked monster(★★★) as sacrifice to boost lower-ranked ones(★~★★).
A monster must be completely enhanced to evolve. Keep boosting your monsters to build the world's top monster squad!

Four is better than three,
and five's more than four!
The fifth slot is for your friend's monster!

You may borrow your friend's monster once a day for exploring.
So, the more friends, the better! Go make more!
You can add friends in your social network and other players as your friends here.
If you want to find your friends, log into your social network account first. It'll be super fun to play with someone you know!
Let's add some players to your Friend List today! Tap the Find button now.
Don't be disappointed if you don't see any recommended friends. Just tap that Recommend button.

Some players might not accept your request. So just send out tons! Try sending one now.

How about this person?
Feeling good about your request? You have to be patient when waiting for the response.
Keep making requests, and invite others to join the game. You can get monsters from the Friendship Cube with the friend points you get.
I hope you continue exploring with many friends!

Hey,
will you help me evolve?

I can learn a skill that cures bad stuff
like poison and bleeding when I evolve.

It will be really helpful
to take me to Desert Island after I evolve.

To evolve a monster, you need
a +5 boosted Lv.30 Material Monster and
a +5 boosted Lv.30 Monster to evolve.

You need lots of inventory space.
Because all monsters have different materials.
Since I'm already in the inventory, pick me.

Please check the evolution material monster
you're planning to strengthen me with.

So you're strengthening me with that monster,
hm? Guess it's time for me to evolve!

Good job! You see that Greebi over there?
He's my evolution material monster!
We both trained very hard for today.

Thank you so much for evolving me!
I will take care of Desert Island from now on!

Your other monsters will also look great and get
strong skills like me after their evolution.

You can find the evolution info by touching the
Evolution Tree button in the monster info window.

Keep checking and exploring and powering
up your monsters!

It's time to test out my skills.
Defeat the horrifying boss of Desert-4.

steps.title: New Quest!
steps.text: Defeat the boss of Desert-4

You truly are the strongest!
I've never seen such skill!
You're a winner!

Compete with other monsters.
You can test your monsters' strength in the Battle
Arena.

Have you been to the Special Islands yet?
These islands are full of special rewards.

Evolution materials.
Rare monsters.
Lots of gold.
TONS of experience...

Let's take a look at the material island, where you
can get Evolution Material monsters.

Do you see the one you've been looking for?
Press this cube to check the dropped monsters in
a field.

Don't forget to get the rewards you want in the
right time zone of the Special Island!

Oh, my! When did your team get so strong?
You must already know that your team's rank can
level up to Rank S++.

If you want to rank your team up to S++, your
monsters must reach Lv. 30 +5, and 5-6★. It will
be a challenge! Getting monsters to 6★ isn't easy!

Once your monsters can't evolve anymore, get
them to +5 Lv. 30.
Then you can use Fusion to make them into even
better monsters.

You're already pretty tough.
From now on, the right combination of skills and
elements will be crucial for PvP.

Aim to rank your team up to S++ and make sure
you have the right elements and skills.
Rank A monster squad can beat Rank S with the
right moves!

sky_island:normal:5.text: What are you trying to prove? Go back, NOW!

sprout_island:normal:1.text:
Doesn't this seed give you special super powers?
I must have it!

sprout_island:normal:2.text:
I'll take out any chump that tries to
mess up MY seed harvest!

sprout_island:normal:3.text:
I can't believe these rookies defeated me.
I'll get them... AFTER I GET YOU!

sprout_island:normal:4.text:
All you can come up with is a rare seed?
That thing wouldn't even make a good snack!

sprout_island:normal:5.text:
It really was a regular seed...
Why are you even here?

lake_island:normal:0.text:
Lake Island is ours.
You're out of your league anyway.
Maybe you should go.

lake_island:normal:1.text:
You show up late and try to swipe my goods?
Haven't you ever heard of fair trade?

lake_island:normal:2.text:
I hear there's a new powerhouse in town.
Don't tell me it's you. That's an awful joke.

lake_island:normal:3.text:
You never do anything right!
Get back to hauling my groceries!

lake_island:normal:4.text:
Check it out! I put some food coloring in this
water, and I'm selling it as a supplement.
Best prank ever!

lake_island:normal:5.text:
Boil the lake...
Instant fish soup!

lake_island:normal:6.text:
Side-effects? Well, there could be.
I dunno, I'M not gonna eat it.

lake_island:normal:7.text:
Look young ones, this is how business is.
Just go play. I'll take care of business.

lake_island:normal:8.text:
Hey! Who are you? You wrecked my facilities!
You'll pay for this!

lake_island:normal:9.text:
You like messing around with my business?
I hope you like swimming... FOREVER!

lake_island:normal:10.text:
Stop it! Fine. I'll leave you alone.
Haha. I can't believe you didn't realize
I was joking! Ha.. haha...

lake_island:hard:4.text:
Check it out! I put some food coloring in this
water, and I'm selling it as a supplement.
Best prank ever!

lake_island:hard:6.text:
Side-effects? Well, there could be.
I dunno, I'M not gonna eat it.

desert_isle:normal:3.text:
Don't give the desert folk the cold-shoulder.
You'll be buried deep in sand.

desert_isle:normal:4.text:
We welcome travelers to the oasis.
That'll be 1 gems for water.

desert_isle:normal:8.text:
The desert nights are unkind. Inexperienced
travelers like yourself could get buried!

desert_isle:normal:9.text:
You mess with one of us,
you mess with all of us!

desert_isle:normal:10.text:
Who are you to interrupt us?
What happens in the desert stays in the desert.

moonlight_desert:normal:0.text:
So, you're the one that survived Desert Island?
You may have made it through the day,
but now you face the night!
I will end your pain here!

moonlight_desert:normal:1.text:
The energy of the night gives me unstoppable power!
I guess you're out of luck tonight...

moonlight_desert:normal:2.text:
You look familiar. Heard a lot about you from my
distant cousin. Shall we test your skills?

moonlight_desert:normal:3.text:
I look so gorgeous and luxurious in the moonlight.
I'm sure your heart is pounding at the sight of me!
Don't be afraid of my beauty!

moonlight_desert:normal:4.text:
Are you here to overcome dark energy?
So, you think you can overcome ME?!
I'll cut you to ribbons!

moonlight_desert:normal:6.text:
The moonlight gave me enough power to overcome the
Seal Stone! I'm unbeatable in the desert night!
Attack me if you can!

moonlight_desert:normal:7.text:
You beat my younger brother?
Let's see how you handle the real deal.
This is for my younger brother!

moonlight_desert:normal:11.text:
Wh-what have you done?!
I underestimated you before, but this stops now.
Get ready for a claw clinic!

boneyard_island:normal:1.text:
You must be strong to make it here.
But this place will be your grave!
Attack, my lizards!

boneyard_island:normal:2.text:
I haven't let anyone through so far.
Be grateful you ran into me!
I'll show you an easy exit.

boneyard_island:normal:4.text:
You beat up Frivolaze? He was a bit clumsy,
but I'm different! Take your time, you'll need it!

boneyard_island:normal:5.text:
I can't believe I have to take matters into
my own hands. You punks are really annoying!
No one has ever passed this area.

boneyard_island:normal:6.text:
You've made it far enough to be heroes.
You just have to make it past one thing...

boneyard_island:normal:7.text:
I'm safe, as long as I have my Frivolaze
to protect me. Frivolaze! Go, and destroy them!
Smash them to bits!

boneyard_island:normal:8.text:
I'm the mercenary who will settle this!
Are you sure you don't want to run for your life?
Have it your way!

boneyard_island:normal:10.text:
You've gotten too far!
I can't let you get the Seal Piece!
This is where your path ends!

boneyard_island:normal:11.text:
Don't go celebrating yet. Even if you make it
past me, you'll never survive Dino Gorge!
Fall to the sound of the Wolverin!

boneyard_island:normal:12.text:
I'm Mantichomp. No one can defeat me!
I'll make you regret coming here! HOWOOOOOO!

boneyard_island:normal:13.text:
So, you've come this far?
If you surrender to me right now, I'll take you
as my pupil. Surrender to the world of Goldverin!

dino_gorge:normal:0.text:
You reek of destruction!
Leave this island.

dino_gorge:normal:1.text:
Sometimes, words aren't enough.
You're never leaving this island!

dino_gorge:normal:2.text:
Dragons never make the wrong decision.
Ruckus-makers beware!

dino_gorge:normal:4.text:
It might have been easy to sneak in,
but you'll never get out alive.

dino_gorge:normal:5.text:
Thieves! They're after the warehouse!
The warehouse is empty? That's ridiculous!

dino_gorge:normal:6.text:
How dare you allow my noble hands to be sullied?!
You vulgar, vile creatures!

dino_gorge:normal:7.text:
So, you made it to the Dragons.
Your flame of terror fizzles out here!

dino_gorge:normal:12.text:
We can rebuild, as long as you're not here.
Unless we lock you up... Forever!

desert_isle:normal:0.text:
Oh, look who's here!
The swindlers that skipped out on my toll!

desert_isle:normal:2.text:
Feeling great, rolling around the hot desert.
Why don't you give it a try?

monster_lines.whirlee:
You want to sacrifice ME?
Well, that won't be so easy!
monster_lines.ruburak:
You must evolve me to get Goldbat!
Mwahaha!
monster_lines.sapphibat:
A gem can shine on its own! How dare you
try to sacrifice one, you reckless wreck!
monster_lines.fire_kong:
Material Beans contain greater power
than you think, despite being Fusion material.
monster_lines.grass_kong:
Material Beans contain greater power
than you think, despite being Fusion material.
monster_lines.water_kong:
Material Beans contain greater power
than you think, despite being Fusion material.
monster_lines.no_kong:
Material Beans contain greater power
than you think, despite being Fusion material.

island_text.sprout_island: Villains are trying to steal the precious seeds on Sprout Island. Please take care of them.
island_text.lake_island: A strange factory appears to be polluting the lake! Please protect that healing water!
island_text.desert_isle:
Desert is bigger and bigger!
Let's stop more Desertification.
island_text.moonlight_desert:
The desert becomes even more
dangerous at night.
island_text.dino_gorge:
We're all going to get eaten!
Why dinosaurs are so angry?
island_text.robo_island: The robot army is preparing to annex the rest of the islands! Somebody needs to stop those metal monsters!
island_text.sky_island: Monsters are trying to escape from the huge door in the sky! You have to stop them before they make it down!

island_clear._source: Footage: Boneyard-14 (part 12 @14:32), Dino-14 (part 25 @4:22) and Sky-8 (Q2NPbbBy8RQ @17:14). Other islands show only the Mission Clear and New Island cards.

before.text:
You finally did it! Unbelievable!
What an amazing team!

after.text:
Dino Gorge is a gorge filled with dinosaurs. Wow!
Beat up the dinosaurs and get their treasure!

before.text:
Congrats! You're a true hero!
Even more challenges await!

after.text:
Robo Island is being dominated by robots.
Go show them what true power is!
